qa.what_happened: I've been dealing with prisoner 6194, who hasn't spoken since day 1. Despite issuing multiple warnings and escalating the situation, he remained silent. The other prisoners followed the rules and complied with our instructions, but 6194's continued silence was starting to wear on me and the other guards.
